title.value: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: PhAST: Physics-Aware, Scalable, and Task-Specific GNNs for Accelerated Catalyst Design

extractions.description: The paper introduces PhAST, a framework that enhances the accuracy and scalability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for catalyst discovery, crucial for reducing carbon emissions in industrial processes. PhAST improves energy MAE by 4 to 42% while dividing compute time by 3 to 8× depending on the targeted task/model. PhAST also enables CPU training, leading to 40× speedups in highly parallelized settings.
